section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1998
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1998 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A) 1.3.5.7 Although break-up of total Government and Private vehicles is not available, it is interesting to note that 94.4 percent victims of `Truck/Lorry', 67.4 percent of `Buses', 93.4 percent of `Tempo/Vans, 93.8% of `Jeeps' and 94.9 percent of cars, involved in accidents, were travelling in private vehicles.
